title: Particle Net
description: A constellation that drifts and connects: the classic particle network, tuned quiet enough for real heroes.
usage: A background for hero sections and empty states: points drift slowly, lines form between near neighbors, and the cursor gathers a small crowd. Density and speed are set low on purpose — a net you notice working is a net set wrong. Real content rides above it in the same panel.
a11y: The canvas is aria-hidden scenery behind real, high-contrast content. Under prefers-reduced-motion a single still constellation is drawn and left alone. If the text cannot be read with the net removed, fix the text.
